# Town of Stannard municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 22; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Jan Lewandoski (Chair), Katy Knuth, and Stephen Lyons for Stannard's three-member board (the directory prints the third member as 'Lyons Stephen'; the name order here follows the directory's surname-first slip). The town has no website, so the directory is the roster of record
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Connie Withers as Stannard's Town Clerk (the June 2026 spreadsheet postdates the March 2026 town meeting)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Connie Withers as Stannard's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Cynthia Wheeler as Stannard's Town Treasurer; the June 2026 treasurer spreadsheet carries no Stannard row ('contact Town Clerk'), so she is seated on disclosed incumbency continuity from the Guide, with no contrary evidence in any official source
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
